```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
```

# Compare Effect Sizes Across Low vs High MOI

```{r load-table-s3}
table_s3_path <- here("data/Table_S3_Final_DC_TAP_Seq_Results_w_Chromatin_Categories_on_resized_and_merged_elements_250908_append.tsv")
table_s3 <- fread(table_s3_path, data.table = FALSE)

grna_target_df <- fread(
	here("results/2026-05-11_SCEPTRE/tables/grna_target_data_frame.tsv"),
	data.table = FALSE
)

table_s3_wtc11 <- table_s3[table_s3$cell_type == "WTC11", ]
tested_elements <- unique(grna_target_df$grna_target)
table_s3_wtc11 <- table_s3_wtc11[table_s3_wtc11$intended_target_name_hg38 %in% tested_elements, ]

sig_pairs <- table_s3_wtc11[table_s3_wtc11$significant == TRUE, ]
validation34_ids <- unique(sig_pairs$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38)
cat("Validation pairs (Table S3 significant):", length(validation34_ids), "\n")
```

```{r load-sceptre-results}
union_dirs <- c(
	"MOI1_1_union",
	"MOI1_5_union",
	"MOI11_3_union",
	"MOI13_union",
	"low_moi_merged_union",
	"high_moi_merged_union"
)

sceptre_list <- lapply(union_dirs, function(dir_name) {
	fp <- here("results/2026-05-11_SCEPTRE/runs", dir_name, "sceptre_discovery_results.tsv")
	x <- fread(fp, data.table = FALSE)
	x$source <- dir_name
	x
})
sceptre_all <- bind_rows(sceptre_list)

gencode_v32_path <- here("data/gencode.v32.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
gencode_genes <- fread(
	cmd = paste("gzip -dc", shQuote(gencode_v32_path)),
	sep = "\t",
	header = FALSE,
	quote = "",
	data.table = FALSE,
	fill = TRUE,
	comment.char = "#"
)
colnames(gencode_genes) <- c(
	"seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score",
	"strand", "frame", "attribute"
)
gencode_genes <- gencode_genes[gencode_genes$feature == "gene", "attribute", drop = FALSE]
gencode_genes$gene_id <- sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gencode_genes$attribute)
gencode_genes$gene_symbol <- sub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gencode_genes$attribute)
gencode_genes$gene_id_stripped <- sub("\\..*$", "", gencode_genes$gene_id)
gencode_genes <- unique(gencode_genes[, c("gene_id_stripped", "gene_symbol")])

sceptre_all$response_id_stripped <- sub("\\..*$", "", sceptre_all$response_id)
sceptre_all <- merge(
	sceptre_all,
	gencode_genes,
	by.x = "response_id_stripped",
	by.y = "gene_id_stripped",
	all.x = TRUE,
	sort = FALSE
)

sceptre_all$pct_change_effect_size <- 100 * (sceptre_all$fold_change - 1)
sceptre_all$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 <- paste(
	sceptre_all$gene_symbol,
	sceptre_all$grna_target,
	sep = "|"
)
```

## Scatter: low_moi_merged vs high_moi_merged

```{r merged-scatter}
merged_df <- sceptre_all %>%
	filter(source %in% c("low_moi_merged_union", "high_moi_merged_union")) %>%
	select(
		element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38,
		source,
		pct_change_effect_size,
		significant
	) %>%
	mutate(significant = ifelse(is.na(significant), FALSE, significant)) %>%
	pivot_wider(
		names_from = source,
		values_from = c(pct_change_effect_size, significant),
		values_fill = list(pct_change_effect_size = NA_real_, significant = FALSE)
	) %>%
	filter(significant_low_moi_merged_union | significant_high_moi_merged_union) %>%
	mutate(
		validation_34 = ifelse(
			element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 %in% validation34_ids,
			"Validation 34 pairs",
			"Other significant pair"
		)
	)

ggplot(
	merged_df,
	aes(
		x = pct_change_effect_size_low_moi_merged_union,
		y = pct_change_effect_size_high_moi_merged_union,
		color = validation_34
	)
) +
	geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
	geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
	geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.5) +
	geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.85) +
	scale_color_manual(values = c(
		"Validation 34 pairs" = "#c51b7d",
		"Other significant pair" = "grey65"
	)) +
	theme_minimal() +
	labs(
		title = "Effect size comparison: low_moi_merged vs high_moi_merged",
		x = "% change effect size (low_moi_merged)",
		y = "% change effect size (high_moi_merged)",
		color = NULL
	)
```

## GGPairs: two low-MOI and two high-MOI samples

```{r ggpairs-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
pair_sources <- c("MOI1_1_union", "MOI1_5_union", "MOI11_3_union", "MOI13_union")

pair_df <- sceptre_all %>%
	filter(source %in% pair_sources) %>%
	select(
		element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38,
		source,
		pct_change_effect_size,
		significant
	) %>%
	mutate(significant = ifelse(is.na(significant), FALSE, significant)) %>%
	pivot_wider(
		names_from = source,
		values_from = c(pct_change_effect_size, significant),
		values_fill = list(pct_change_effect_size = NA_real_, significant = FALSE)
	) %>%
	filter(
		significant_MOI1_1_union |
			significant_MOI1_5_union |
			significant_MOI11_3_union |
			significant_MOI13_union
	) %>%
	mutate(
		validation_34 = ifelse(
			element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 %in% validation34_ids,
			"Validation 34 pairs",
			"Other significant pair"
		)
	)

plot_cols <- c(
	"pct_change_effect_size_MOI1_1_union",
	"pct_change_effect_size_MOI1_5_union",
	"pct_change_effect_size_MOI11_3_union",
	"pct_change_effect_size_MOI13_union"
)

shared_limits <- range(unlist(pair_df[, plot_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)

lower_fixed_axes <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
	ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
		geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
		geom_abline(
			slope = 1,
			intercept = 0,
			linetype = "dashed",
			color = "black",
			linewidth = 0.4
		) +
		scale_x_continuous(limits = shared_limits) +
		scale_y_continuous(limits = shared_limits) +
		theme(
			axis.text = element_text(size = 4),
			axis.title = element_blank()
		)
}

ggpairs(
	pair_df,
	columns = plot_cols,
	mapping = aes(color = validation_34),
	diag = list(continuous = wrap("densityDiag", alpha = 0.5)),
	upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", size = 4)),
	lower = list(continuous = wrap(lower_fixed_axes))
) +
	scale_color_manual(values = c(
		"Validation 34 pairs" = "#c51b7d",
		"Other significant pair" = "grey65"
	)) +
	labs(title = "Effect size concordance across replicate low/high MOI runs") +
	theme(
		axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
		axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
	)
```
